 EUGENE, OR — A tense standoff on West 24th Avenue ended with a 38-year-old man in custody Saturday afternoon after a neighbor reported he had smashed a window and was outside her home with a handgun.
 At 1:41 p.m. Oct. 24, Eugene police received a call from a resident on West 24th Avenue who said her neighbor had smashed a window and was now outside her home with a handgun.
 Police identified the suspect as Jesse Barnum, 38. Officers said Barnum returned to his home and refused to come out when police arrived.
 Police negotiated with Barnum, and at one point he came out of the home and was semi-cooperative before going back inside, according to police.
 At 3:40 p.m., Barnum exited the residence again and cooperated with police, who took him into custody. He was taken to the Lane County Jail. Charges are pending.
